slides.texte_overlay:
Green flags in a man
that people notice instantly

1. He can laugh at himself

No ego to protect.
That's real confidence.

2. He still talks to his family

Calls his mother.
Visits without a reason.

3. He can cook a real meal

Not just pasta.
Something he's proud of.

4. His best friends
are old friends

People don't stay
for years by accident.

5. He's the same online
and offline

No character. No act.

6. He's always learning
something

Ask him what he read lately.
He has an answer.
slides.texte_sophia:
6. He's always learning
something

My habit: 5 minutes a day
on the Sophia app.
Ask me what I learned.
